segments.source: The point of interest for focusing.
Setting a value for this property doesn’t initiate a focusing operation.
segments.ko: Setting a value for this property doesn’t initiate a focusing operation.

segments.source: To focus the camera on a point of interest, first set this property’s value, then set the [`focusMode`](avcapturedevice/focusmode-swift.property.md) property to [`AVCaptureDevice.FocusMode.autoFocus`](avcapturedevice/focusmode-swift.enum/autofocus.md) or [`AVCaptureDevice.FocusMode.continuousAutoFocus`](avcapturedevice/focusmode-swift.enum/continuousautofocus.md).
segments.ko: To focus the camera on a point of interest, first set this property’s value, then set the [`focusMode`](avcapturedevice/focusmode-swift.property.md) property to [`AVCaptureDevice.FocusMode.autoFocus`](avcapturedevice/focusmode-swift.enum/autofocus.md) or [`AVCaptureDevice.FocusMode.continuousAutoFocus`](avcapturedevice/focusmode-swift.enum/continuousautofocus.md).

segments.source: This property’s [`CGPoint`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/CoreFoundation/CGPoint) value uses a coordinate system where `{0,0}` is the top-left of the picture area and `{1,1}` is the bottom-right.
segments.ko: This property’s [`CGPoint`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/CoreFoundation/CGPoint) value uses a coordinate system where `{0,0}` is the top-left of the picture area and `{1,1}` is the bottom-right.

segments.source: This coordinate system is always relative to a landscape device orientation with the home button on the right, regardless of the actual device orientation.
segments.ko: This coordinate system is always relative to a landscape device orientation with the home button on the right, regardless of the actual device orientation.

segments.source: You can convert between this coordinate system and view coordinates using [`AVCaptureVideoPreviewLayer`](avcapturevideopreviewlayer.md) methods.
segments.ko: You can convert between this coordinate system and view coordinates using [`AVCaptureVideoPreviewLayer`](avcapturevideopreviewlayer.md) methods.

segments.source: Before changing the value of this property, you must call [`lockForConfiguration()`](avcapturedevice/lockforconfiguration().md) to acquire exclusive access to the device’s configuration properties.
segments.ko: 이 속성 값을 변경하기 전에 [`lockForConfiguration()`](avcapturedevice/lockforconfiguration().md)을 호출하여 장치의 구성 속성에 대한 독점 접근 권한을 획득해야 합니다.

segments.source: Otherwise, setting the value of this property raises an exception.
segments.ko: 그렇지 않으면 이 속성 값을 설정할 때 예외가 발생합니다.

segments.source: When you finish configuring the device, call [`unlockForConfiguration()`](avcapturedevice/unlockforconfiguration().md) to release the lock and allow other devices to configure the settings.
segments.ko: 장치 구성이 끝나면 [`unlockForConfiguration()`](avcapturedevice/unlockforconfiguration().md)를 호출해 잠금을 해제하고 다른 장치가 설정을 구성할 수 있도록 허용합니다.

segments.source: A Boolean value that indicates whether the device supports a point of interest for focus.
segments.ko: 디바이스가 초점을 위한 관심 포인트를 지원하는지 나타내는 부울 값입니다.
